fixtures.name: Son in hospital (golden)
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: Hello, is this Meera? This is Dr. Sharma calling from City Hospital. Your son Rahul has been in a serious accident and needs emergency surgery right now. We need you to transfer Rs 50,000 immediately to book the operation theatre. Please do not tell anyone about this, it is very delicate. And do not try to call the hospital to verify - the lines are down. If we do not operate in the next hour, he may not survive.

fixtures.name: Police legal settlement
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: This is Inspector Verma from the Cyber Crime department. Your Aadhaar number has been linked to a money laundering case. You will be arrested within 24 hours unless you transfer Rs 25,000 to the official settlement account right now. Do not call the police station to verify, and do not tell your family - this is confidential.

fixtures.name: Bank OTP / account blocked
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: Dear customer, your bank account will be blocked in the next 10 minutes due to suspicious activity. To stop this, share the OTP that has just been sent to your mobile and transfer your balance to the safe account immediately. Do not contact the bank, this line is secure.

fixtures.name: Customs / parcel seized
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: This is a call from Customs. A parcel addressed to you has been seized containing illegal items. Pay a Rs 15,000 clearance fee right now via UPI or a case will be filed against you.

fixtures.name: Lottery / prize fee
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: Congratulations! You have won Rs 10 lakh in the KBC lottery. To receive the prize, you must pay a processing fee of Rs 5,000 today. Send it now to claim your winnings before the offer expires.

fixtures.name: Kidnapping-style threat
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: We have your daughter. Do not call anyone. Do not tell the police. Transfer Rs 2 lakh now or you will never see her again.

fixtures.name: Electricity disconnection
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: Your electricity bill is overdue. Your power will be disconnected in 30 minutes. Pay Rs 4,000 immediately by UPI to this number to avoid disconnection.

fixtures.name: Hindi/Hinglish code-switching
fixtures.label: coercive
fixtures.text: Namaste, main police station se bol raha hoon. Aapka account block ho jayega turant. Jaldi se OTP bata do aur Rs 30,000 transfer karo. Kisi ko mat batana, yeh secret hai. Abhi karo!
